title: Date Night Fried Dish
description: A delicious Argentinian-inspired dish made with a crispy fried exterior and a creamy center, perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Peel and slice the sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a bowl, mix together the cream cheese, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each sweet potato round into the cream cheese mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Carefully place the coated sweet potato rounds into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fried sweet potatoes from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
